payload.title: a guard is no larger than its one act
payload.body: Held while refusal-way-forward realizes enforcement scope; amend when it closes. enforcement scope bounds what a guard hands its judge but says nothing about the guard itself, so the operator's ask (guard workers are bloated) is measured by no shard. Add: a guard carries only what its one act needs (read the event, decide whether it applies, ask the judge, relay the verdict and the way forward); everything else it carries is a defect. stance-workers-lean cut the workers from 14 KB to 6 KB and 50 KB to 15 KB with byte-identical behaviour; the clause makes that the standard, not a one-off.
